name: Remedy
what: A presenter at a counter shows a remedy from tradition step by step, then the product as today's version; one gross hook, every step shown, the payoff close.

specialised.what: video spice at level 3 in the brief
specialised.why: the owner 2026-10-20: realism is emotional connection; mechanical cuts and faces read as AI (tools/video-production/VIDEO-SPICE.md)

specialised.what: one step per line; the clip prompt carries the shot's action the whole time
specialised.why: whisking said but not shown, the lime never squeezed (2026-10-20)

specialised.what: prop masters at real size, a reference in every shot
specialised.why: the nose model changed size across the reel (2026-10-20)

specialised.what: picture check before any clip, by the model house judge
specialised.why: a book open and shut at once (2026-10-20)

specialised.what: the voice is a per-line read fitted to the lips, never one take stretched across clips

stage_order: teardown (or the format's own writer for an organic topic)
writing + spice (video spice level 3, realism index writing entries)
shots (one step per line, angle, camera, hands_off, props)
set (once per presenter) + prop masters (product = the real photo)
pictures (carry-over across the whole piece) + picture check
voice (per line, delivery as a v3 tag)
clips (Seedance 2.5, 480p, action in the prompt, end frame on continuous hand-offs) + clip check
edit (edits-glow captions, pace breathing, room tone, match/whip)

audio.fit: none — the locked read is the clip's own audio; nothing is fitted afterwards
audio.delivery: the shot's `delivery` as a v3 audio tag

pictures.set: one locked set per presenter; every first frame is an edit of it
pictures.carry: reel — every shot carries over from the shot before, across beats
pictures.props: one master picture per prop at its real size, referenced in every shot it appears in; the product master is the real product photo
pictures.life_marks: the presenter's life marks in every picture
pictures.realism: realism index production entries (skin, place) for the format
pictures.check: picture check (model-house behind.judge): impossible objects, prop size, missing action, malformed hands; one remake with the judge's fix

clips.prompt_order: the shot's action ('What happens in this shot, the whole time') → the presenter's face and voice → the hold note → the camera move → the realism index production entries (camera-hand, face)
clips.end_frame: a `continuous` hand-off ends on the next shot's first picture (end_image_url) so the join disappears
clips.check: clip check (model-house behind.judge): the shot kept its object, the camera did not jump, nothing new entered; one remake with the strict hold note
clips._seedance: 2026-10-26: every clip is Seedance 2.5 at 480p, one take and three tries at most (VIDEO-RULINGS V34, MODEL-HOUSE.md); a clip is 4 s at the least

hooks.how: 3 concepts per topic built from the levers (literal · huge · texture · action · split), judged 'would you stop on this with the sound off'
hooks.first_frame: the oversized model of the problem at the lens, the remedy already on it

captions.place: aim at the neck, move off any face or mouth
captions.timing: exact word timings handed to the editor (model-house sound.words)
captions.emphasis: the step's action, the ingredient, the payoff word, the comment word — about one word in six

edit.pace: breathing — cuts between shots only, no splits at breaths, no punch-in jumps
edit.room_tone: the set's room tone from the SFX bank
edit.transitions: from the shot plan's hands_off: match and whip drawn; continuous and action are plain cuts

copy.ask: the lane's: organic = comment the word and follow; paid = tap the button. Nothing else changes between lanes (RUN-PROTOCOL.md, one machine)

failures.failure: the camera jumped to her face and dropped the hook prop
failures.fix: hold note in every clip prompt; the clip check remakes a clip that lost its object

failures.failure: choppy, fragment script; voice restarted every cut
failures.fix: monologue first, then shots; the script judge scores it against the real reels

failures.failure: mechanical: 16–17 short shots, pause splits and punch-ins, one take stretched onto lips, the same excited face
failures.fix: 9–13 shots, pace breathing, per-line read fitted to lips, emotion and face per shot

failures.failure: a book open and shut at once; malformed hands
the nose model changed size between shots
failures.fix: prop masters at real size, referenced in every shot

failures.failure: whisking and squeezing the lime said but never shown
failures.fix: one step per line; the clip prompt carries the action

failures.failure: captions over her mouth in wide shots; words up to 0.8 s off her voice
failures.fix: edits-glow aims at the neck and moves off faces; exact Scribe word timings in the kit

cost._cap: 2026-10-21 (P40, VIDEO-RULINGS V5/V17): no dollar cap; cost is never a reason to stop or to take a lesser element.
cost.measured: about $6–8 a reel on 2026-10-20 (11–17 clips on the old Omni route at 720p, 13–17 GPT Image edits, line reads)
cost.how: one version of every start picture and one take of every clip, each judged, another only if it fails (three tries at most); an element none of whose three passes is HELD and made again, never shipped (VIDEO-RULINGS V5, 2026-10-21; was: one picture per shot, one remake max per check)

quality_bar: the hook frame stops a thumb with the sound off
every step said is shown, in order
one object, one look: props and the product never change
her face travels with the words; never the same excited face throughout
no caption ever covers a face or a mouth; words land within 3 frames
cuts land between shots; nothing feels chopped or mechanical
built_from: the Grandma Yai reels, 2026-10-20 (the owner's sandbox reel line, grandma-yai/)
rulings: the owner 2026-10-20: organic and paid are the same video; only the ask and how gradual the pitch is differ
the owner 2026-10-20: don't worry about over claiming, it's content
the owner 2026-10-20: captions on her neck, never her mouth
